review_id.description: The id of the review you decided, such as cr_01...

decision.description: The decision you sent to the server, or SKIP when you sent none.

summary.description: What you checked, naming the page URLs, and why you decided as you did.

risks.description: What may still be wrong, one entry each.

field_findings.description: For a product-schema review, each field found wrong or doubtful.

outcome.description: Whether the server took your decision.

kind.description: The error kind of a refusal, such as CONFLICT; empty otherwise.

failed_checks.description: The check names of a refusal, such as TOO_FEW_LABELS.

detail.description: The refusal's reason or error, briefly; empty otherwise.
